jobs.occupation: Order picker in night shift - English allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you a true night owl who performs best during the night? Do you already have some experience in order picking or logistics? Are you looking for a physically challenging role with job security? Then this could be the perfect job for you!

For a stable and growing transport company in Oostkamp that specializes in frozen food logistics, we're looking for an order picker to join the team in the freezer in the night shift. Do cold temperatures not scare you at all and do you speak English well? Then don't hesitate to apply, because the company is very welcoming to speakers of Dutch and English!

The job

As an order picker, you're the corner stone of the company's logistical processes. You work in the freezer every night to prepare orders for supermarkets throughout Europe.

Your responsibilites include:

• Making orders based on order lists
• Preparing completed orders for shipment
• Taking the orders to the loading docks for the trucks
You do all of this using an electrical pallet truck (also known as an "EPT").

Be sure to apply if you:

• Have experience in orderpicking or other warehouse work
• Aren't afraid of physically heavy work in a freezer environment
• Feel at your absolute best at night and are looking for a night job
• Have your own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)
Experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT) is a big plus, but not required.

!! Please note: you need to live in Belgium for this job. Actief cannot help you immigrate nor provide housing. If you don't have an official address in Belgium, you don't qualify and cannot apply !!

Do you hold a valid CE driving licence and code 95? Are you already living in Belgium and looking for a stable job? And do you want to work at a reliable transport company where you can drive modern trucks and be home almost every evening?

For a leading frozen food transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we're recruiting a CE truck driver for delivering frozen food products to customers throughout Belgium and its neighbouring countries. Dutch isn't required for this job, so you're free to apply if you only speak English!

Your job

As a CE truck driver, lorry driver, or HGV driver, you will ensure the safe and on-time delivery of frozen food products to supermarkets, distribution centres, and business customers.

Your drives:

• Transport of frozen goods
• National deliveries throughout Belgium, but also to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, France and Germany 
• Average of 12h/day on the road (waiting and resting times included)
• Between 5 to 15 stops/day
• Never on weekends or on holidays
Routes are prepared in advance and your trailer is already loaded, connected, fuelled, and ready to go before departure.

You'll almost never have to sleep in your truck, except for some for very exceptional cases when there's no other possibility.

We're looking for a driver who:

• Has a valid CE driving licence and code 95
• Is residing in Belgium and has legal right to work in the country
• Has a good level of English
• Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes
• Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby   truck cannot be taken home)
Experience as a CE truck driver is a big advantage but not required. You can also apply if you've just gotten your CE driving licence!

Global Safeguarding Strategy and Culture  
    
•   
Enhance and oversee the delivery of the OCB Safeguarding Strategy ensuring it is enhanced, developed, and maintained and monitored, and is a mainstreamed issue within OCB 
    
•   
Provide strategic vision to drive through essential, systematic integration of SG into all of OCB's work 
    
•   
Act as strategic lead for all constituents of safeguarding in OCB operations, with specific emphasis on preventative aspects of work 
    
•   
Build a culture that embodies a consistent tone, energy and language on Safeguarding 
    
•   
In close collaboration with OCB departments and Executive Leadership Team, drive the integration of safeguarding roles and responsibilities throughout all aspects of OCB's work    
     
OCB Safeguarding Systems, Policies and Systems 
    
•   
Ensure that standards of safeguarding are maintained across all parts of OCB 
    
•   
Ensure a robust and effective case management process & work to enhance the case management system  
    
•   
Ensure the development of staff capacity through the promotion and embedding of safeguarding policies and procedures across the movement 
    
•   
Oversee the Case Management and Reporting Standard Operating Procedure (SOPs) 
    
•   
Enhance and maintain OCB Safeguarding standards and Operating Procedures to take into consideration learning through implementation and necessary changes    
     
Thought Leadership and Influencing 
    
•   
Participate in stakeholder engagement including participation in international sector platforms on safeguarding, benchmarking market best practice and positioning OCB as a thought subject -matter leader 
    
•   
Strengthen the SG voice within program design, risk assessment and mitigation and safe programming in a coordinated and consistent way 
    
•   
Ensure the integration of safe programming and safeguarding risk management throughout the project cycle, including safe and accessible community-based reporting mechanisms for SEAH and adequate safeguarding response capacity at country level, in close collaboration with the Operational Department 
    
•   
Lead the coordination of safeguarding positioning and external engagement within the wider sector and represent OCB externally on sector wide debates on safeguarding management    
     
Leadership of Safeguarding resources 
    
•   
Engage with the members of the IPOB and Safeguarding network of colleagues across the movement 
    
•   
Lead, support, and develop the OCB Safeguarding Team   
    
•   
Management and leadership of the safeguarding team 
    
•   
Ownership and management of the Safeguarding Unit budget 
    
•   
Work with the HR Director to ensure compliance with safeguarding policies, including safe recruitment practices 
    
•   
Monitor activity to ensure there is an adequate resource for the Safeguarding Unit 
   

Education & Experience 
    
•   
Relevant qualification in safeguarding, law, ethics, social work, gender-based violence or a related field, and/or at least five (5) years' experience preventing, detecting and responding to sexual exploitation, abuse, harassment and other forms of misconduct 
    
• Sexual Exploitation, Abuse and Harassment (SEAH) investigation qualification (e.g. CHS Tier 3, CFE, CFF, CPA, CCEP or equivalent recognised certification)   
• Minimum five (5) years' experience in a strategic role within a complex organisation   
• Minimum five (5) years' experience working within an international NGO, UN agency or comparable international environment   
• Experience leading or conducting safeguarding investigations and managing highly sensitive and confidential matters   
• Experience working in multicultural and transversal environments and building trust across all organisational levels   
• Experience leading and developing multicultural teams       
Competencies 
    
•   
Critical thinking, analytical and decision-making skills for the protection of vulnerable people 
    
• People management, team leadership and influencing skills in complex organisational cultures   
• Strong cross-cultural communication and stakeholder engagement skills   
• Experience in multicultural and transversal environments   
• Ability to synthesise information from multiple sources with strong attention to detail   
• Experience drafting strategic documents, policies, standard operating procedures and guidelines   
• Strong organisational and time management skills   
• Ability to handle sensitive information with discretion   
• Strong commitment to creating a safe working environment where people are heard and concerns are addressed   
• Integrity, ethical judgement and self-awareness    
 
  
Languages 
    
•   
Proficiency of English, both written and spoken is mandatory 
    
•   
Good knowledge of French, Spanish, or Arabic is an asset      
     
Other 
    
•   
Availability for international travel, including programme visits and safeguarding-related meetings

Our client is a leading international industrial group with operations across multiple continents and an ambitious growth strategy driven by innovation and strategic investments.To strengthen its specialist M&A Legal team, the organisation is looking to appoint a Senior Legal Counsel based in Brussels.

Jobomschrijving

As Senior Legal Counsel - M&A, you will act as lead legal adviser on high-profile international transactions.Your responsibilities will include:

• Leading the legal execution of domestic and international acquisitions, divestitures, joint ventures and strategic investments.
• Managing complex legal due diligence exercises and coordinating specialist legal input across multiple jurisdictions.
• Drafting, reviewing and negotiating transaction documentation, including share purchase agreements, joint venture agreements, transition service agreements, NDAs and other ancillary documents.
• Advising on transaction structuring and identifying pragmatic solutions to legal and commercial risks.
• Partnering with internal stakeholders across Corporate Strategy, M&A, Finance, Treasury, Tax, HR, IT and Compliance throughout the deal lifecycle.
• Managing signing, closing and post-closing processes.
• Supporting integrations, carve-outs and corporate reorganisations following completed transactions.
• Coordinating and managing external legal counsel internationally while maintaining ownership of transaction execution.
• Advising senior management on strategic legal considerations impacting investment decisions.
• Contributing to the continuous development of the company's M&A legal function and best practices.

• Belgian Master's degree in Law.
• Approximately 8  years of post-qualification experience in Corporate/M&A law.
• Experience gained within a leading international law firm and/or a sophisticated international in-house legal environment.
• Demonstrated experience leading complex domestic and cross-border M&A transactions.
• Excellent drafting, negotiation and project management skills.
• Strong commercial judgement and ability to translate legal complexity into practical business advice.
• Confident communicator with the ability to influence senior stakeholders.
• Fluent in English. French and/or Dutch are considered strong assets.

Michael Page is a globally recognised recruitment consultancy specialising in the placement of qualified professionals and managers across a wide range of sectors, including Finance, Human Resources, Sales & Marketing, Engineering, Supply Chain, Digital & Technology, Legal, and more.As part of our continued growth in Belgium, we are looking for ambitious and driven individuals to join our Brussels office and contribute to our success while building their own professional career.

Jobomschrijving

As a (Senior) Recruitment Consultant your responsibilities are:Business Development & Sales

• Identify and prospect new business opportunities within your market.
• Develop and manage a portfolio of clients across different industries.
• Conduct client meetings to understand hiring needs and business challenges.
• Negotiate commercial agreements and recruitment partnerships.
• Build long-term relationships with key decision-makers and HR stakeholders.
• Become a trusted advisor for your clients regarding talent acquisition and market trends.
Recruitment & Talent Acquisition

• Source and engage top talent through LinkedIn, job boards, networking, and referrals.
• Conduct interviews and assess candidates' skills, experience, and motivations.
• Present qualified candidates to clients and manage the interview process.
• Deliver an exceptional candidate experience throughout the recruitment journey.
• Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline within your specialisation.
Client Relationship Management

• Act as the main point of contact for your clients.
• Provide market insights and salary benchmarking.
• Ensure a high level of service and client satisfaction.
• Develop long-term partnerships based on trust and expertise.

A successful (Senior) Recruitment Consultant should have:

• Previous experience in sales, business development, recruitment, consulting, customer service, or a commercial role.
• Strong interest in business development and client relationship management.
• Entrepreneurial mindset and passion for achieving results.
• Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
• Resilient, ambitious, and motivated by targets and performance.
• Ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
• Fluent in French and English or Dutch and English.

For our client in Merchtem, we are looking for an Inside Sales Representative to support and develop customer relationships across Eastern Europe.Our client is an international wholesaler specialising in industrial sealing solutions, including O-rings, technical seals and customised sealing products. The company supplies technical distributors and industrial trading partners worldwide.You will join a small, internationally oriented sales team where customer relationships, technical understanding and commercial initiative are equally important.Your focus will be on managing existing accounts while identifying opportunities to develop new business. Approximately 70% of your activities will involve existing customers, with the remaining 30% focused on new customer acquisition.What will you do? 
• Manage and develop relationships with existing B2B customers. 
• Identify potential customers and open new accounts. 
• Work closely with the External Sales Representative to develop sales opportunities. 
• Prepare quotations, calculate prices and follow up on commercial proposals. 
• Process customer orders and monitor their progress. 
• Maintain regular contact with customers by telephone and email. 
• Identify cross-selling opportunities within the existing product range. 
• Encourage customers to use the company's digital ordering tools. 
• Handle customer enquiries, complaints and commercial requests. 
• Keep customer information accurate and up to date in the internal system. 
• Develop an understanding of customer applications, market developments and competitors. 
• Monitor commercial opportunities and report on sales activities. 
• Support colleagues when needed and contribute to the daily operation of the sales department.
 
• You have a commercial and/or technical background. 
• You have at least 4 years of experience in B2B sales, preferably involving technical products. 
• You are fluent in English, both written and spoken. 
• Knowledge of Polish, Czech or another Eastern European language is a strong advantage. 
• Knowledge of French and/or Arabic is an additional asset. 
• You are comfortable working with Excel and other business software. 
• You enjoy maintaining customer relationships and identifying commercial opportunities. 
• You communicate clearly and confidently with international customers. 
• You are organised and capable of managing several customer requests simultaneously. 
• You take initiative and follow up on commercial opportunities without needing constant supervision. 
• You work well in a small team and remain focused when priorities change. 
• An interest in industrial products and technical applications will help you succeed in this role.

For our client in Merchtem, we are looking for an Inside Sales Representative to develop business across the Middle East and Africa.Our client is an international wholesaler of industrial sealing solutions, supplying technical distributors and industrial trading partners. Its product range includes O-rings, industrial seals and customised sealing products for a wide variety of applications.The company is looking for a commercially driven professional who enjoys approaching potential customers, developing new accounts and turning opportunities into actual sales.This position has a strong business development focus. You will work closely with the External Sales Representative to expand the customer portfolio across the MEA region while continuing to develop relationships with existing clients.What will you do? 
• Actively identify and approach potential B2B customers across the Middle East and Africa. 
• Prospect for new business opportunities and open new customer accounts. 
• Follow up on commercial leads and convert opportunities into sales. 
• Build relationships with new customers and develop long-term business opportunities. 
• Maintain and expand existing customer accounts. 
• Identify opportunities for cross-selling and upselling. 
• Prepare quotations and follow up on commercial proposals. 
• Process orders and respond to customer enquiries. 
• Maintain regular contact with customers by telephone and email. 
• Understand customer requirements and propose suitable sealing solutions. 
• Work closely with the External Sales Representative on commercial activities and customer development. 
• Monitor sales opportunities and report on commercial progress. 
• Provide professional customer service and ensure timely follow-up of requests.
 
• You have a commercial and/or technical background. 
• You have experience in B2B sales and/or customer service. 
• You genuinely enjoy prospecting and approaching new customers. 
• You are confident initiating commercial conversations and following up on opportunities. 
• You are fluent in English and French, both written and spoken. 
• Knowledge of Arabic is an advantage, but not a requirement. 
• Experience with customers in the Middle East or Africa is a plus. 
• Experience selling technical or industrial products is an additional asset. 
• You are comfortable working with Excel and general business software. 
• You communicate clearly and know how to build professional relationships. 
• You take initiative and are motivated by commercial results. 
• You can work independently while maintaining close contact with your sales colleagues. 
• You are customer-oriented, persistent and organised in your approach.

jobs.occupation: Senior Accountant in Brussels - International company

jobs.description:
Our client is a leading international insurance company with a strong presence in the Belgian market. Through innovation, customer-centricity, and operational excellence, the organization continuously invests in transforming and growing their Business Units.To support the successful execution of its strategic ambitions, our client is currently looking for a Strategic Change Analyst to join its Brussels-based office.

Jobomschrijving

• Support the definition, structuring and monitoring of the Business Unit strategic roadmap
• Translate strategic priorities into compelling communication materials, executive presentations and impactful storytelling
• Prepare presentations, reports and strategic updates for senior management and executive committees
• Conduct business and strategic analyses to support decision-making and identify growth opportunities
• Perform ad hoc studies related to profitability, operational efficiency, organizational effectiveness and innovation
• Develop recommendations and action plans based on data-driven insights
• Contribute to the optimization and simplification of internal processes across the business unit
• Coordinate and monitor strategic initiatives, transformation projects and change management activities
• Support the annual budgeting process and oversee the monitoring of business unit operating expenses
• Prepare financial analyses, budget forecasts and management reporting
• Collaborate closely with Finance teams on cost allocation, financial planning and performance monitoring
• Act as a key liaison between business stakeholders and Finance to ensure alignment on financial objectives and priorities
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives within budgeting, reporting and governance processes

• Master's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Insurance or a related field
• Minimum 5 years of professional experience in strategy, consulting, business analysis, project management, transformation or change management
• Strong understanding of the Life Insurance sector, including products, regulations and market dynamics
• Experience supporting strategic planning, business transformation and roadmap execution
• Excellent analytical skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable recommendations
• Strong financial acumen with experience in budgeting, financial analysis and management reporting
• Proven ability to create impactful presentations and deliver effective executive-level storytelling
• Experience in process improvement and cross-functional project coordination
• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills across multiple business functions
• Highly organized, autonomous and capable of challenging assumptions in a constructive manner
• Ability to synthesize complex information and present clear conclusions to management
• Fluency in French/Dutch and English, both written and spoken.

Our client is a fast-growing private markets investment platform offering investors access to carefully selected private equity opportunities through a diversified fund-of-funds approach.

Jobomschrijving

As an Investment Relations & Fundraising Manager, you will:

• Develop and execute fundraising initiatives to attract new investors across Belgium and Luxembourg.
• Identify, qualify and build relationships with high-net-worth individuals, entrepreneurs, family offices and other private investors.
• Create and maintain a targeted prospect pipeline, defining market priorities and developing effective outreach strategies.
• Present private equity investment opportunities to prospective investors and clearly articulate the investment rationale.
• Lead investor meetings, networking events and fundraising discussions.
• Build trust-based, long-term relationships with existing and prospective investors.
• Act as a key ambassador for the firm's investment solutions and market positioning.
• Work closely with the investment team to gain a deep understanding of underlying funds, portfolio construction and investment strategies.
• Monitor fundraising activity, investor feedback and market developments to support future growth initiatives.
• Contribute to the firm's expansion by identifying new opportunities within the private wealth ecosystem.

The successful Investment Relations & Fundraising Manager has the following profile :

• About 5 years of experience within private banking, wealth management, investor relations, fundraising, private markets or a related investment environment.
• Strong understanding of private equity and alternative investments.
• Previous exposure to fundraising, capital raising or investor acquisition activities is highly desirable.
• Ability to confidently engage with sophisticated investors and explain complex investment concepts in a clear and compelling manner.
• Demonstrates strong interpersonal skills, credibility and executive presence.
• Able to build conviction and establish trust with experienced investors.
• Entrepreneurial, proactive and comfortable working within a growing business.
• Fluent Dutch, French and English is strongly preferred.
